title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in WP Go Maps WP Go…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in WP Go Maps up to version 10.1.12. This flaw allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling an attacker with low privileges to execute malicious scripts in the context of the affected site. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity level.
